caption:
You didn't lose that job on price.

You lost it because the other shop let the customer book a date on the first call, and you said you'd follow up.

Test it this week: have a friend, not you, call your shop and ask for an appointment. Time how many calls it takes before a real date lands on a calendar.

If it takes more than one call, fix your booking process before you touch price.
